description: This file is a shell script containing tests for Git rebase functionality. It sets up repositories, runs rebase commands, and verifies various behaviors and edge cases of git rebase, including author info preservation, handling of worktrees, and rebase options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expecting certain conditions to be met.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expected to fail, confirming failure behavior.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that output from a command is empty.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a command's output.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new test repository for subsequent operations.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified content.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Adjusts the commit timestamp for testing.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets Git configuration options for tests.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares revisions to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that might fail; does not fail the test if it does.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
